question.text: What are the trading hours for INR-based currency futures?

answer.text: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:15 AM to 3:30 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM
Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

explanation.text: The Logic: INR-based currency futures trade Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. On the expiry day, the expiring contract trades only until 12:30 PM. The Trap: 9:15 AM - 3:30 PM is the equity-market timing; cross-currency futures have their own separate trading window and are not the INR-pair timing. Note: The 12:30 PM cut-off applies only to the contract that is expiring on that day — all other INR futures contracts continue trading until 5:00 PM.
